dispatcher.configuration: Frozen WorkflowConfig dataclass with I2V_CONFIG and V2V_CONFIG constants; per-call explicit operation, no mode mutation
dispatcher.equivalence: Both routed baselines are structurally identical to the native golden exports; no guessed sampler or virtual links
dispatcher.hash_contract: Run.workflow_hash remains the historical mode-specific raw golden export hash. input_info.workflow_provenance records canonical template hash, operation and effective config. input_info.workflow_api_sha256 hashes the exact persisted parameterized workflow_api.json bytes separately.
dispatcher.legacy_builder_compatibility: normal/continuation constructor aliases retained for older callers, not separate production instances

operation_isolation.shared: Single backend lock, active slot, memory guard, dispatcher, Store and ComfyClient; network cancellation/atomic publication/telemetry preserved
operation_isolation.unchanged: Request schemas, default prompts/literal Markdown, accepted-parent gate, role/identity inheritance and limits, WebSocket before submission, long-wait, no file polling, own-prompt cancellation and no restart replay

sequence_contract.scope: Only requested end-run ancestor chain, in root-to-end order; no sibling selection, scanning, copy, migration or mutable sequence index
sequence_contract.storage: Existing runs/<id>/chunk.mp4 and manifests stay independent and in place
sequence_contract.duration: Stored video probe duration when available; explicit requested fallback for legacy manifests without verified duration
sequence_contract.video_url: Existing /runs/<id>/video URL for ready/reviewed states, null for unavailable states
sequence_contract.guards: Canonical IDs, contained own-chunk paths, manifest IDs, cycles, missing/unaccepted ancestors, approval contradictions, malformed nested probe data and nonfinite/invalid duration
sequence_contract.io: Query reads only JSON manifests; tests forbid binary reads, video access and inference. No concatenation or decoding in sequence endpoint.
sequence_contract.real_chain_state: Both accepted, two blocks at2.333333s each; HTTP200; accepted manifest/video hashes unchanged before/after read-only verification

validation.lint_command: uv run ruff check src tests
validation.frozen_files: git diff --exit-code d974ce0 -- workflows prompts src/h3_backend/comfy.py src/h3_backend/media.py src/h3_backend/models.py passed
validation.coverage: Dataclass immutability, only canonical graph runtime source, golden graph equality, routing allowlist, both-mode object-info validation, exact roles/Markdown/limits, no cross-run graph leaks, explicit aliases, cross-operation global slot, running RAM guards, shutdown/failures, literal artifact hash/provenance, lineage branching/cycles/path/approval guards and malformed metadata HTTP400

runtime_safety.note: CPU regression tests retain existing synthetic FFmpeg fixtures; no new real chunk or preview generated

scope: No frontend, no post-processing removal, no model/sampler/resolution/attention/VAEs/decode/saver changes, no push; exact approved refactor only
